latest_audits.result: Official code strongly confirms a real reversible multi-stage improvement loop, adaptive holdout rotation and best-effort decision persistence. A new exact scope correction was found in the quality stage: with case weights present, the gate thresholds a weighted mean but uses the unweighted sample SD/sqrt(n) as its standard error. Since approved case weights are arbitrary nonnegative values with no upper bound, this is not a general 95% confidence bound for the weighted estimator. An independent finite checker enumerates a bounded null with n=5, deltas +/-0.02 and weights [100,1,1,1,1]; expected weighted gain is zero yet 16/32 null outcomes pass the quality stage even with the default 1pp effect floor. This is a quality-stage counterexample, not an observed end-to-end AgentOpt false-promotion rate; hard constraints/reliability/coverage/holdout can still veto. The unweighted z=1.645/sample-SD bound is also only approximate at small n, and no anytime/candidate-family spending was found.
